question: How did the lithium content of the NMC622 change after delamination?
rendered: The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials before and after delamination was measured by using an inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometer (ICP-OES, Agilent Technologies 5110). After delamination, the lithium content was reduced from 1.015 to 0.993.
